root_cause.text: After auxiliary_device_uninit() triggers the release callback that frees the containing mana_adev structure (which holds the auxiliary_device as an embedded member), the subsequent fall-through code accesses adev->id, resulting in a use-after-free because adev is part of the freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "The auxiliary device has its release callback set to adev_release(), which frees the containing struct mana_adev. Since adev is embedded in struct mana_adev, the subsequent fall-through to init_fail and access to adev->id may result in a use-after-free." The patch fixes this by saving the allocated auxiliary device id in a local variable before calling auxiliary_device_add() and using that saved id in the cleanup path after auxiliary_device_uninit().
